description:
Get your little cyclist one stride closer to their first pedal. Rolling on grippy pneumatic tire and a steel frame, the Speed 12in. balance bike has some of the same features you see on adult bikes. Balance bikes teach kids how to balance on two wheels, making the transition to their first bike, nothing but fun.

Their first bike is a beautiful thing, it’s even better if it’s not their first expensive bike. Designed to get new riders rolling without breaking the bank. Our Speed Balance bike is a great value and built to last, so it will be ready for the next rider

Tough steel frame is durable enough to get multiple generations of riders, rolling

Air filled tires offer great grips and a smooth ride

Solid seat is supportive and super durable

Best suited for ages 2 to 3 years

Tool-free seat adjustment makes it easy to resize for growth spurts and new riders

Bell lets little riders announce their presence

Soft grips are the right size for little hands, providing a confident connection

Textured footrests on the chain stays keep feet off the ground when they’re on a roll

When your new bike arrives, there are a couple steps between unpacking and riding. First turn the handlebars until the fork faces forward, then holding the front wheel inline with the back wheel, turn the handlebars until they are at a right-angle. At this point your bike should look like it does on MEC.ca. Now you need to tighten everything down, start with the 2 stem bolts. After that, adjust the handlebars to match your rider’s natural grip height, tighten the 4 bolts on the front faceplate. With those 3 quick steps done, your little rider is ready to roll! We know this is a bit of extra work, but this streamlined shipping decreases the bike’s carbon footprint
